user_input: write me  a poem about Alexander the Great in a Shakespearean style
model_output:
In ancient times, a king did reign,
Whose name was Alexander, great and plain,
His conquests vast, his armies fierce,
He conquered lands, with his sword in hand, with unnerving ferocity.

From Greece he came, and Asia he did claim,
With power and might, he ruled the land,
His army strong, his will unbroken,
He fought with skill, and never was daunted.

He stood against the Persians, with a fierce desire,
To prove his might, and see his power increase,
And though the odds were great, he never wavered,
But charged into battle, with his sword unfurled.

He built cities, and opened trade,
His name became known, throughout the world,
For he was a conqueror, of great renown,
His legacy lives on, still today, in stories and songs.

So let us remember, the great deeds he did,
And the strength of his arm, that none could defeat,
For Alexander the Great, was a name to fear,
A warrior and king, whose legend will always endure.
